figure: PART LOCATIONS — UNDERSIDE OF CHASSIS PT-42, PT-44
scope: Numbered component callouts in Philco's underside parts-location drawing. The diagram is a 2D parts locator, not a wiring, lead-dress, dimensional, or 3D placement drawing.

position_callouts.note: The drawing uses one #29 callout for both electrolytic sections.

not_shown_policy: These parts remain in the 33-part factory register. The p.38 underside position figure does not provide a numbered location for them; supplemental PT-44 photographs provide qualitative location evidence for #3, #4, and #27 only, without establishing wiring, lead dress, scale, or game coordinates.

observations.limitations: The photograph has no part label or terminal detail.

observations.finding: A two-section variable tuning capacitor is visible on the chassis top side and mechanically linked to the tuning control.
observations.limitations: The photograph does not expose gang terminal identities or wiring.

observations.finding: The speaker assembly is visible mounted inside the cabinet.
